Off the heat, fold in the diced jamón, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Spread 2 cm thick on an oiled tray, film in contact. Blast chill to ≤4 °C within 90 min; rest overnight at 0–4 °C.
Portion the MASA at 32 g; roll into cylinders.
Pass through flour, egg and panko; repeat egg and panko for a second coat.
Fry at 180 °C for 3 min until deep gold, core ≥75 °C (from frozen: 175 °C, 4 min).
